name: building-blocks-field-adornments
title: Field Adornments
description: Tiny Tailwind field primitives for labels, leading icons, trailing meta, helper rows, and counters around native inputs.
useWhen: Tiny Tailwind field primitives for labels, leading icons, trailing meta, helper rows, and counters around native inputs.
avoidWhen: Avoid field adornments when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Field Adornments uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
